briefdescription.para: Callback function supplied by the application.
Function to close a SD peripheral specified by the SD handle.

detaileddescription.para: The functions are based on SD.h Descriptions will appear there, and expanded here where relevant for WFF3.
======== SDWFF3_close ======== When closing the peripheral, IOs will be reset to what is configured by SysConfig. If power-off while sleep defined in Sys-Config then card must be initialized too.

simplesect.para: SD_open() had to be called first.

briefdescription.para: Function for setting control parameters of the SDWFF3 driver after it has been opened.

detaileddescription.para:
======== SDWFF3_control ========
SDWFF3_open() has to be called first.
handle
A SDWFF3 handle returned from SDWFF3_open()
cmd
The command to execute, supported commands are:
Command
SD_STATUS_SUCCESS
SD_STATUS_ERROR
SDWFF3_CMD_IS_CARD_CONNECTED
Card is connected
Card is NOT connected
SDWFF3_CMD_IS_CARD_WRITE_PROTECTED

Card is write protected
arg
Not used in SDWFF3.

briefdescription.para: Function to obtain the total number of sectors on the SD card. Note: Total Card capacity is the (NumberOfSectors * SectorSize).

simplesect.para: SD Card has been initialized using SD_initialize().
The total number of sectors on the SD card, or 0 if an error occurred.

detaileddescription.para: The sector size of SD card is always 512 bytes

briefdescription.para: This function initializes the SD driver.

simplesect.para: The #SD_config[] array must exist and be persistent before this function can be called. This function must also be called before any other SD driver APIs. This function call does not modify any peripheral registers.
For initializing the driver correctly, review the example for using the driver above.

briefdescription.para: Function to initialize the SD card.

simplesect.para: SD controller has been opened by calling SD_open().
SD_STATUS_SUCCESS if no errors occurred during the initialization, SD_STATUS_ERROR otherwise.

briefdescription.para: Function to open the SD peripheral with the index and parameters specified.

simplesect.para: SD controller has been initialized using SD_init().

parameterdescription.para: There is one SDWFF3 so index = 0.

Pointer to a SDWFF3_Param block. SDWFF3CallbackFxn - call-back function for the application. The function must be SDWFF3EventCB type. See example above for template. minDmaTransferSize - Define the threshold for using DMA in transaction. If the number of sector is bigger than minDmaTransferSize, DMA will be used.

simplesect.para: A SD_Handle on success or a NULL on an error or if it has been opened already.

memberdef.argsstring: (SD_Handle handle, void *buf, int_fast32_t sector, uint_fast32_t secCount)
memberdef.name: SDWFF3_read

briefdescription.para: Function that reads the specified sectors from the SD card. The destination is specified by buf. The starting sector is specified by sector and the total number of sectors to read is provided by secCount.

simplesect.para: SD controller has been opened and initialized by calling SD_open() followed by SD_initialize().

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to a buffer to read data into.
Starting sector on the disk to read from.
Number of sectors to be read.

simplesect.para: SD_STATUS_SUCCESS if no errors occurred during the write, SD_STATUS_ERROR otherwise.

memberdef.argsstring: (SD_Handle handle, const void *buf, int_fast32_t sector, uint_fast32_t secCount)
memberdef.name: SDWFF3_write

briefdescription.para: Function that writes data to the specified sectors of the SD card. The source is specified by buf. The starting sector to write is specified by sector and the total number of sectors to write is provided by secCount.

simplesect.para: SD controller has been opened and initialized by calling SD_open() followed by SD_initialize().

parameterdescription.para: Pointer to a buffer containing data to write to disk.
Starting sector on the disk to write to.
Number of sectors to be written.

simplesect.para: SD_STATUS_SUCCESS if no errors occurred during the write, SD_STATUS_ERROR otherwise.
